title: Wilford Woodruff
notes: ~280 individual articles A-Z; very high KG value (each = concept node)

footnotes.text: Reid L. Neilson, ed.,In the Whirlpool: The Pre-Manifesto Letters of President Wilford Woodruff to the William Atkin Family, 1885–1890(Norman, OK: Arthur H. Clark, 2011), 204–206. By some counts, Woodruff married more than eight women, although historians disagree on the exact number. At least three of his plural marriages ended in divorce. See Laurel Thatcher Ulrich,A House Full of Females: Plural Marriage and Women’s Rights in Early Mormonism, 1835–1870(New York: Knopf, 2017), 156–57, 266.
